title: Put goal-driven agents to work across repetitive enterprise workflows

hero.title:
Put goal-driven agents to
work across repetitive
enterprise workflows
hero.summary: Agivant builds agentic AI systems that read a goal, work across the tools that hold the task, and take the next action on their own. Agents run multi-step work across IT, operations, and customer teams, improve from what each cycle returns, and stay observable and policy-controlled from the first deployment. Enterprises move from one high-value process to production-grade AI agents in days and weeks.

data.heading: Give agents a goal and let them work the tools
data.description: Agentic AI works from a stated objective. An agent reads that objective, chooses the systems and the sequence that reach it, brings a person in where judgment belongs, and repeats the pattern at scale.
data.closingStatement: Agents earn their place when they close the work, and Agivant builds them to do exactly that.

title: Turn every customer conversation into decisions teams can act on

hero.title: Turn every customer conversation into decisions teams can act on
hero.summary: Verbatim AI reads the whole conversation, transcript, sentiment, emotion, and intent, and returns the summary, the signal, and the next action. Agents get live guidance on the call; managers see the trend across thousands of them. Raw recordings become decision-ready insight in days and weeks.

data.heading: Read the full conversation in one pass
data.description: Verbatim AI reads the words alongside sentiment, emotion, and keywords, so each call carries its meaning, transcript, sentiment, and emotion together. Insight arrives live and as a summary once the call ends.
data.closingStatement: Once every call is readable, the patterns across them become the asset.
